conditionsAndCounterexample.evidence: Conditions are entry price and horizon; stale-by-next-session price caveat, early lock-up release and different close named as reversal conditions; risk-averse savers excluded.

sourceAndAssumptions.evidence: Packet basis reported; CNBC re-read live; lock-ups attributed to the S-1 with 424B4 body unread and disclosed; no dollar close, 7.3% or $97.17 figure printed.

usefulness.evidence: Page answers the post-IPO question: how to buy now, where open-price and IPO-price buyers stand, and what decides hold or buy, using CNBC-reported prices and one arithmetic identity.
